listenings.text: Hi Stephanie, this is Professor Hale. I have your email in front of me, so let me answer the three questions. First, the deadline. If you want to start in the fall, the application has to be complete by the first of March. After that date the committee will not look at it. Second, the sponsor. If the department accepts you, the hospital will sponsor the visa, but only for six months. Third, the language certificate. It is a requirement, and there is no way around it. If you send everything before March and the committee likes the project, you will hear from us in April. If not, we will keep the file for the following year.

Thank you for calling the exam registration line. Please listen carefully, because two things changed this year. If you register before the thirtieth of the month, you will pay the standard fee. After that date there is a late fee, and we cannot remove it. If you need to change your test date, you can do it once, free of charge, up to fourteen days before the exam. If you change it later than that, you will lose part of the fee. And if you cancel completely, we will refund only half. Please do not call to ask for exceptions. The system applies the same rule to everybody.
